lead: A doc link to a `#[cfg(test)]` item, or to another module's private `fn`, builds clean, passes clippy and fails only `nv verify --doc`.
body: `nv verify`'s default gate does not include the doc leg and only a `DONE` claim runs it, so every unresolvable link a goal writes is inherited by the goal's last session as a wall of `broken-intra-doc-links`. Write a `#[cfg(test)]` item in plain backticks, path-qualify one that lives in a sibling module (`[`registration::Action`]`), and add `()` to a name that is both a function and a module.
